purpose: Real-time concurrent CLM W4 ↔ EEG mediator-framing measurement protocol — replaces partial cross-day analysis (state/n_1_bridge_v2_partial_2026_05_02/verdict.json F-ARTIFACT) with statistically powered N=180+ concurrent samples

eeg.electrode_montage: 10-20 standard 16ch (Fp1, Fp2, F3, F4, C3, C4, P3, P4, O1, O2, F7, F8, T3, T4, T5, T6)

clm_compute.tool: tool/edu_l_ix_kuramoto_driver.hexa OR W4 closed-loop ledger driver

sync.method: Lab Streaming Layer (LSL) outlets on both EEG and CLM driver
sync.ground_truth_marker: user-pressed keyboard event (LSL marker stream) at each phase boundary

phases.user_action: sit still, eyes open, gaze at fixation cross
phases.predicted_clm: W4 active branch at fixed-point; gate_random ~constant

phases.user_action: sit still, eyes closed, breathe normally
phases.predicted_eeg: Berger response: α power 2-5x increase at O1/O2
phases.predicted_clm: no change expected (CLM not coupled to user state)

phases.user_action: eyes open, READ live CLM W4 closed-loop ledger output (terminal tail -f) and verbalize one observation per minute
phases.predicted_eeg: frontal β/γ engagement, reduced posterior α
phases.predicted_clm: no autonomic coupling expected; gate_random fluctuations driven by W4 stochasticity

phases.user_action: eyes closed, serial-7 subtract from 1000 (cognitive load control)
phases.predicted_eeg: frontal θ increase, posterior α suppressed
phases.predicted_clm: control: should show NO correlation (proves CLM-to-EEG link is not just user-aware)

phases.user_action: eyes closed, count breaths 1-10 cyclically (mindfulness control)

data_pipeline.step_1_record: OpenBCI GUI or BrainFlow → LSL EEG outlet → record to .npy (16ch × 125Hz × 1800s = 3.6M samples) + LSL marker stream for phase boundaries
data_pipeline.step_2_clm_concurrent: ubu1: launch tool/edu_l_ix_kuramoto_driver.hexa in continuous-emission mode (1Hz tick) + W4 closed-loop ledger writer with LSL outlet for tension/gate trace
data_pipeline.step_3_filter: tool/an11_b_eeg_ingest v2_b2b3 — butterworth-4 zero-phase 8-12Hz + Hilbert α-phase per channel; output state/clm_eeg_alpha_phase_realtime_2026_05_XX.json
data_pipeline.step_4_window: 1-second windows (N=1800 per phase × 6 phases = 10800 EEG windows; subsample CLM to 1Hz → 1800 paired samples per phase)
data_pipeline.step_5_align: LSL clock-sync: align EEG window centers to nearest CLM tick; reject paired samples with sync drift > 10ms
data_pipeline.step_6_analysis: Re-run Phase 2/3/4 from N-1 v2 partial verdict but with N=180+ paired samples per phase (vs N=5 in partial); compute Pearson per phase, Granger lag-1 to lag-5, TE with surrogate-shuffle null (100 surrogates), permutation p with N>=1000

pre_registered_decision_rules.PASS_threshold: ANY phase shows |r| > 0.3 with permutation p < 0.01 AND TE > surrogate p99 AND directionality (TE_fwd vs TE_bwd) consistent across >=3 of 6 phases
pre_registered_decision_rules.FAIL_threshold: no phase shows |r| > 0.2 with permutation p < 0.05
pre_registered_decision_rules.ARTIFACT_check: shuffle-EEG control must yield |r| < observed |r| with p_shuffle_exceeds < 0.05
pre_registered_decision_rules.freezing: thresholds frozen by this protocol document; do not modify after data collection (raw#10 honest C3)

specify_in_advance: channel selection: P3+P4+O1+O2 alpha-rich avg PLV (frozen)

control_conditions.shuffle_eeg: must yield no |r| spike — confirms observed coupling is non-degenerate
control_conditions.shuffle_clm: must yield no |r| spike — symmetric check
control_conditions.phase_label_shuffle: shuffling phase labels should destroy any phase-specific effect
control_conditions.common_cause_audio: metronome at 1Hz throughout; subtract to ensure W4↔EEG coupling is not via user audio entrainment

go_no_go_checklist: [ ] EEG impedance < 10kΩ on all 4 alpha-rich channels (P3/P4/O1/O2)
[ ] LSL CLM outlet streaming verified (ubu1 hexa runtime active)
[ ] LSL clock sync drift < 10ms confirmed in 60s warmup
[ ] User in low-EMI room (per Apr-28 D-day relocation lessons)
[ ] Pre-registered thresholds frozen in this doc
